rule: No number without reporting period and source.
No institutional relationship without documentary evidence.
No claim of authority without legal or constitutional basis.
No person-role connection without a dated appointment or institutional record.
Page/note/table/section locator required for document-derived facts.
Unknown, not reconciled and not evidenced are valid values; zero is never inferred from absence.
Public institution/brand and reporting legal entity are stored separately.
Taxpayer, Lottery, local-tax, tax-relief, philanthropy, sponsorship and earned-income routes remain separate.
Historical claims are never overwritten by later strategy or office-holder records.
Strategy claims and observed machinery/results are independent records joined only through evidence.
